texts.li: "Is this the place that took in {FACTION} folk when they had nowhere to go?" {X_nameDef} asked. When {A_nameDef} said it was, {X_nameDef} took {A_possessive} hand and held on to it for a long time.
A cousin of {X_nameDef}'s owes this colony a life, {X_pronoun} told {A_nameDef}, and the whole family knows the colony's name because of it.
Over supper {X_nameDef} told the table, and {A_nameDef} in particular, what {FACTION} say about this place: that it took in their people when it didn't have to.
{X_nameDef} knocked a good part off the price before {A_nameDef} had even started to haggle. "{FACTION} remember their friends," {X_pronoun} said, and wouldn't hear another word about it.
{X_nameDef} set aside the best of the goods for {A_nameDef} and threw in some silver besides, for what the colony once did for {FACTION}.

{A_nameDef} went to haggle with {X_nameDef} and found nothing to haggle over. The price was fair before {A_pronoun} opened {A_possessive} mouth, and {X_nameDef} counted back more change than {A_pronoun} was owed.
{X_nameDef} served {A_nameDef} last, after everyone else, and named a price twice what it should have been. "{FACTION} have long memories," was all {X_pronoun} said.
{X_nameDef} wouldn't haggle with {A_nameDef} at all, and put the goods away the moment {A_nameDef} said where {A_pronoun} was from.
It took {A_nameDef} most of an afternoon to talk {X_nameDef} round to an ordinary price, and {X_nameDef} brought up what this colony did to {FACTION} twice along the way.
{X_nameDef} wouldn't sit at the same table as {A_nameDef} and took {X_possessive} supper outside. It was over what this colony did to {FACTION}, one of the other visitors said.
{A_nameDef} offered {X_nameDef} a cup of water at the gate. {X_nameDef} looked at it, then at {A_nameDef}, and walked past.
{X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef}, quite politely, whether the colony still does the kind of thing it did to {FACTION}. {A_nameDef} didn't know what to answer.
{X_nameDef} mentioned, lightly, that {FACTION} once helped this colony when it needed it, and wondered aloud whether anyone here remembered.
{FACTION} don't keep accounts of what they give their neighbors, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and then told {A_objective} exactly what they had given this colony.
